registry_purpose: Describe independent Trump-related archives as a federated research network without pretending that unlike record units are interchangeable or additive.
invariants: An upstream archive is a discovery and corroboration source, not an automatic authority for The Record.
Every measurement preserves the upstream label, unit, scope, observation time, and primary project page that displayed it.
Counts from different comparability groups are never summed into a grand total.
An external item does not become a verified The Record entry without source-level review under The Record's editorial standard.

A directory card or crosslink is discovery infrastructure, not a completed import. Every external item that advances beyond research_lead must receive facts, significance, goalpost/response, maybe_therefore, evidence/confidence, provenance, consequences, and revision layers.

Origin archive plus origin record ID and deterministic dedupe_key are unique gates. Same-event archive records are merged as attributed origins; later stages of the same action share an event_family_key and remain explicitly crosslinked instead of being collapsed.
External IDs and URLs remain attached after deduplication so readers can audit provenance and return to the upstream record.
No full-text republication occurs until the upstream license or explicit permission permits it. Metadata, short descriptions, citations, and links are the default federation boundary.
A failed or stale upstream check never erases the last known measurement; it changes the check state and preserves the previous observation.

comparability_groups.raw_public_expression: Posts, speeches, transcripts, interviews, or official documents. These are source artifacts, not policy events.
comparability_groups.general_policy_action: Confirmed executive, regulatory, agency, personnel, or court-linked policy actions across multiple domains.
comparability_groups.domain_policy_action: Policy actions within a named subject domain; this registry currently includes immigration.
comparability_groups.structured_executive_conduct: Curated executive-conduct entries, evidence documents, contradictions, sequences, and consequence relationships.
comparability_groups.archive_feature_metric: A feature-specific upstream count such as primary documents, contradictions, or sequences; not an event total.

measurement_contract.value_rule: Use null only when the upstream project does not expose a verified numeric value on a checked primary page. Never infer a count from API limits, page numbers, search snippets, or record IDs.
measurement_contract.display_rule: Render the unit and scope beside every number. Do not present a cross-archive sum.

field_rules.the_record_entry_id: Null until a new canonical entry is accepted, or the existing canonical ID when the federation record is crosswalk-only.
field_rules.external_record_unit: Preserve the upstream archive's unit verbatim; never convert it into an additive The Record count.
field_rules.dedupe_key: Deterministic federated-record-v1 fingerprint for one event at one lifecycle stage.
field_rules.event_family_key: Stable fingerprint shared by proposal, implementation, litigation, reversal, and outcome stages of the same action.
field_rules.maybe_therefore_state: May be pending only for research_lead; must be complete for every later status.

proposed_federation_pipeline.principle: One research home requires more than a directory: a registry and preserved upstream links feed deduplicated federated records, and every record that advances past research_lead receives The Record's complete sourced and interpretive structure before it can appear as reviewed or published.

stages.name: registry_health_check
stages.action: During each six-hour run, check only archives whose recommended interval is due. Record HTTP state, checked_at, last_successful_fetch_at, last_changed_at, upstream displayed date, ETag or Last-Modified when available, and parser version.

stages.name: metadata_staging
stages.action: Retrieve permitted metadata into an append-only staging layer. Preserve upstream ID, canonical URL, record unit, title, dates, lifecycle state, source URLs, retrieval time, and a payload hash.

stages.name: candidate_crosswalk
stages.action: Match formal identifiers first, canonical source URLs second, and title/date or quote fingerprints last. Never merge merely because two titles sound similar.

stages.name: source_identity_and_duplicate_review
stages.action: Create research_lead records with preserved archive IDs and units. Inspect original sources, calculate deterministic dedupe_key and event_family_key values, merge same-event origins as aliases, and crosslink distinct lifecycle stages. Duplicate origin or event keys block every reviewed or published status.

stages.name: interpretive_normalization
stages.action: Before any record advances beyond research_lead, require atomic sourced facts plus significance, goalpost/response, maybe_therefore, evidence tier and confidence, provenance and copyright boundary, consequences, duplicate clearance, and append-only revisions. External archive prose is not a fact source and is not bulk-copied.

stages.name: public_archive_network
stages.action: Publish archive cards, unit-specific counts, scope and cadence notes, check health, and confirmed crosslinks. Federated records appear only at their validated status; reviewed and published records render the complete interpretive structure. Show no grand total.

stages.name: quality_receipt
stages.action: Record changed counts, new and merged origins, dedupe decisions, lifecycle crosslinks, interpretive gate results, rejected candidates, upstream failures, schema or parser changes, and licensing decisions.

failure_behavior: Use the last successful snapshot and mark it stale.
Do not turn parser failure into a zero count.
Do not delete a crosswalk merely because an upstream URL is temporarily unavailable.
Do not advance a duplicate, an unlinked lifecycle update, or a record missing maybe_therefore beyond research_lead.
Alert when a count falls unexpectedly, a scope label changes, or an upstream site contradicts its own displayed totals.
Require a parser-fixture test before deploying any upstream adapter change.

recommended_feature_adoption.recommendation: Keep raw posts, speeches, and documents in a separate artifact layer, then link them to verified events rather than counting each utterance as an event.
Add proposed, implemented, in litigation, partially blocked, reversed, expired, restored, and outcome-measured states with dated transitions.
Connect a policy to the rule or directive it replaced, later implementation, litigation, court actions, rescission, replacement, and continuing effect.
Add normalized evidence tiers, confidence and dispute states, human-review state, source preservation, official responses, contradiction arcs, consequence chains, and revision history.

Treat external archives as discovery and provenance inputs. Every record that advances beyond research lead must be rewritten from inspected sources into facts, significance, goalpost/response, maybe_therefore, evidence/confidence, provenance, consequences, and revisions, with no copied bulk prose.

Search The Record first and show separately labeled external results by unit. A public-statement result, policy action, immigration policy, and executive-conduct entry must retain different badges and never collapse into an undifferentiated count.
